verdict.rationale: The axis applies because Chargebee ships in-product AI that answers questions and completes tasks in the Billing UI, so it could plausibly consume external MCP servers. However, all MCP evidence covers the server role only: Chargebee MCP Servers and custom MCP servers expose Chargebee's own tools to outside clients like Cursor and Claude. Nothing shows Chargebee's AI connecting to third-party MCP servers to use their tools.
